                {...labelling}

                <path
                  fill="#000000"
                  opacity="0.45"
                  transform="matrix(0.0740 0 0 -0.0740 107.45 157.20)"
                  d={B_GLYPH_PATH}
                />

              viewBox="0 0 10 10"
              fill="none"
              className={cn(
                'h-2.5 w-2.5 transition-transform duration-200',
                active && 'rotate-180',
              )}
            >
              <path
                d="M2 3.5 5 6.5 8 3.5"
                stroke="currentColor"
                strokeWidth="1.5"
                strokeLinecap="round"
                strokeLinejoin="round"
              />

          className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin-slow"
          viewBox="0 0 100 100"
          fill="none"
          xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
        >
          <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="10" fill={color} />

                      <path
                        strokeLinecap="round"
                        strokeLinejoin="round"
                        strokeWidth="2"
                        d="M5 13l4 4L19 7"
                      />

<svg
          className="orbit-lines"
          viewBox={`0 0 ${w} ${h}`}
          style={{
            position: 'absolute',
            inset: 0,
            width: '100%',
            height: '100%',
            pointerEvents: 'none',
            overflow: 'visible',
          }}
        >
          <style>
            {
              'path { fill: none; stroke-linecap: round; } circle.pulse { filter: drop-shadow(0 0 6px var(--color-brand)); }'
            }
          </style>
          {lines}
        </svg>,
